items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I think Ollie Powers and I had the biggest voices... we'd stand -- Ollie and I'd just stand in the middle of the floor... and start our songs

ctx.x: Yeah. The whole orchestra. And they played with just the same -- I don't know, when I'd start, they'd go on with me, and when I'd finish up I'd throw up my hand and they'd stop. And if I wanted to start a song -- not only me, but the rest of the singers, they'd start, I'd start -- they'd start a song, why they'd pick it up and go right on. But I think Ollie Powers and I had the biggest voices, so the rest of them mostly used to have to go up close to them so they could hear them.
Never used megaphones in those days?
